0.why: src/Portal.cpp:529-548, getVoltage(baseChannel + n) is read for sixteen channels across the four roles

1.why: src/Portal.cpp:525-549, for each of the four roles getVoltage() reads channels 4r to 4r+3 as audio, gate, pitch and velocity envelope, each multiplied by the crossfader's B gain and added to the same channel of deck A

12.why: src/Portal.cpp:566, tanh of the mix times 5

14.why: src/Portal.cpp:590, tanh of the cue mix times 5

comment: The deck inputs get no family because the two audio channels in each group of four sit alongside a gate, a pitch and an envelope; the cable carries all four kinds. The isolator and the drive are applied to the master only (src/Portal.cpp:556-564); the cue path is built separately and takes neither. The isolator's gain law is a squared taper below centre, reaching silence, and a straight line above it to a gain of four, which is +12dB, although a comment beside it at src/Portal.cpp:108 says +6dB. The crossfader is a custom horizontal slider at half sensitivity rather than a knob (src/Portal.cpp:333-376), and the cue control is a custom round button. The panel prints Timeline, Groove, Foundation, Lead, Gate, Pitch, Vel / Env, From UniRhythm Poly Out, Poly in A, Cross CV, Poly in B, LOW, MID, HIGH, DRIVE, A and B either side of the fader, Cue Out and Master Output. Lettering is drawn in code at src/Portal.cpp:629-766.
